userStories.title: Build-time Dockerfile: pre-create bun-owned /home/bun/.claude and install jq
userStories.description: As a container-mode operator, I need the worker image to pre-create /home/bun/.claude as a bun-owned directory before the re-home chown and to ship jq, so a freshly-created claude-code-config named volume mounts bun-owned (not root-owned) on first use and agent scripts that assume jq work in-container.
acceptanceCriteria: The .devcontainer/Dockerfile creates /home/bun/.claude as a directory (e.g. mkdir -p) at a point strictly BEFORE the `chown -R $HOST_UID:$HOST_GID /home/bun` step, so a first-mount named volume inherits bun ownership from the image dir rather than being created root-owned by Docker. [oracle: file-assert - the mkdir of /home/bun/.claude appears on an earlier line than the `chown -R "$HOST_UID:$HOST_GID" /home/bun` line in .devcontainer/Dockerfile]

The .devcontainer/Dockerfile apt-get install line includes jq alongside the existing packages (git nodejs npm sudo iptables ipset dnsmasq dnsutils curl). [oracle: grep -q 'jq' .devcontainer/Dockerfile]

userStories.title: New src/supervisor/container-config.ts mirroring container-firewall.ts
userStories.description: As the sidecar boot path, I need a self-contained module that builds the docker-exec argv to chown /home/bun/.claude and to re-assert the 5 CAM-179 config keys jq-free, plus a non-throwing orchestrator and a typed error, so ensure-up can un-shadow the root-owned volume and repair a claude-rewritten .claude.json deterministically and testably.
acceptanceCriteria: A new module src/supervisor/container-config.ts exports a pure builder for the chown docker-exec argv whose shape runs `chown -R <uid>:<gid> /home/bun/.claude` inside the named container (e.g. ['exec', containerName, 'chown', '-R', '<uid>:<gid>', '/home/bun/.claude'] or the equivalent root-escalated form). [oracle: bun test - argv-shape assertions in test/supervisor/container-config.test.ts]

The module exports a pure builder for the config re-assert docker-exec argv that runs jq-free in-container node (nodejs is installed) and merges the 5 CAM-179 keys (hasCompletedOnboarding, theme, bypassPermissionsModeAccepted, projects[/workspace].hasTrustDialogAccepted, projects[/workspace].hasCompletedProjectOnboarding) into /home/bun/.claude.json WITHOUT clobbering claude's own state (machineID/userID). [oracle: bun test - argv contains the node invocation and all 5 key names, and a test asserting a merge rather than a whole-file overwrite]

The module exports a non-throwing orchestrator (e.g. applyContainerConfig) that drives both exec steps through an injectable spawnFn and returns a discriminated union {ok:true} | {ok:false,exitCode,stderrTail}; it NEVER throws on a non-zero exit (failure is a return value), mirroring applyContainerFirewall. [oracle: bun test - ok case, fail case carrying exitCode+stderrTail, and a not-throw assertion]

The module exports a typed error class (e.g. ContainerConfigError) that extends Error, has a stable name, and carries a stderrTail field; it is thrown by the CALLER (US-003 ensureWorkerContainer), never by the orchestrator. [oracle: bun test - instanceof Error, name assertion, stderrTail assertion]

The module structurally mirrors src/supervisor/container-firewall.ts (pure builder(s) + non-throwing orchestrator returning the union + caller-thrown typed error); the orchestrator body contains no throw statement. [oracle: file-assert - grep confirms no 'throw' inside the orchestrator function; reviewer-judgment on structural parity]

Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]

userStories.notes: New files: src/supervisor/container-config.ts, test/supervisor/container-config.test.ts. Mirror src/supervisor/container-firewall.ts EXACTLY (FirewallSpawnFn captures stderr; buildFirewallExecArgv pure; applyContainerFirewall never throws; FirewallError caller-thrown). GOTCHA: the config re-assert is a DISTINCT step from the chown - chowning the .claude DIR does not repair the sibling FILE /home/bun/.claude.json content. GOTCHA: claude STRIPS the baked bypassPermissionsModeAccepted:true on its first config rewrite, so this must be a merge that re-asserts the 5 keys, preserving claude-owned fields like machineID/userID. GOTCHA: reused containers built before this fix have NO jq, so the re-assert must go through in-container node (the image has always shipped nodejs), not jq. The 5 keys and their nesting come from .devcontainer/claude-config.json. Bun/TS: noUncheckedIndexedAccess - guard all argv/regex indexing. Read scripts/cam/patterns.md at story start.

userStories.title: Wire container-config into ensure-up + fail-closed in runSidecar
userStories.description: As the sidecar boot path, I need ensureWorkerContainer to run the chown + config re-assert UNCONDITIONALLY on every ensure-up (alongside the firewall apply) and runSidecar to fail-closed on a config error, so a reused or freshly-created container always starts bun-writable and zero-prompt and a repair failure aborts before any worker is dispatched.
acceptanceCriteria: ensureWorkerContainer invokes the container-config orchestrator UNCONDITIONALLY after the 4-branch reconcile (reused|started|created|rebuilt), gated on an injected spawn seam mirroring firewallSpawnFn; on a {ok:false} result it throws the typed ContainerConfigError. [oracle: bun test - config exec is invoked on all four reconcile branches in test/supervisor/ensure-container.test.ts]
The config apply is a complete no-op when the injected seam is absent (host mode / legacy callers): zero config exec calls. [oracle: bun test - absent-seam branch asserts no config exec occurs]

The chown uses HOST_UID/HOST_GID resolved via resolveHostIds already computed inside makeProductionEnsureContainerFn (not hardcoded). [oracle: file-assert - grep shows resolveHostIds' uid/gid threaded into the container-config wiring in src/supervisor/ensure-container.ts; reviewer-judgment]

runSidecar catches ContainerConfigError via a NEW instanceof arm (mirroring the FirewallError arm at sidecar.ts ~1160-1168): it logs the stderrTail to an operator-facing message and RETURNS before runSidecarLoop, so no worker is dispatched. [oracle: bun test - runSidecarLoopFn spy is NEVER called and runSidecar resolves without throwing when ensureContainerFn throws ContainerConfigError]

Non-matching errors from ensureContainerFn are still rethrown (the new arm does not swallow unexpected errors). [oracle: bun test - a TypeError thrown by ensureContainerFn propagates out of runSidecar]
src/commands/sidecar.ts contains an `instanceof ContainerConfigError` check. [oracle: grep -q 'instanceof ContainerConfigError' src/commands/sidecar.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]

Live real-docker convergence (fresh volume AND pre-existing root-owned volume, zero EACCES, modal-lines 0) is DEFERRED to the operator CAM-175 re-ceremony exactly as CAM-176 deferred real-daemon firewall convergence; it is NOT an autonomous story.
